post_title: What year-over-year revenue growth rate will Amazon report for its AWS segment in Q3 2026?

question.title: What year-over-year revenue growth rate will Amazon report for its AWS segment in Q3 2026?
question.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is Amazon's cloud-computing division and its highest-margin segment, treated by investors as the company's main earnings and stock catalyst. Amazon reports AWS segment net sales and their year-over-year growth each quarter in its official earnings release.

Recent AWS year-over-year quarterly growth rates: Q2 2025 +17.5% ($30.9B), Q3 2025 +20% ($33.0B), and Q2 2026 +37% (to roughly $42.2B, a ~$169B annualized run rate) — described by Amazon as AWS's fastest growth in 18 quarters. Growth has been reaccelerating, driven by AI-related cloud demand. In its headline bullets Amazon typically states AWS growth as a whole percent, while the segment tables provide exact net-sales figures from which a more precise rate can be computed.

For Q3 2026 (quarter ended September 30, 2026), analyst consensus for AWS growth is around 38%, with some analysts (e.g., BNP Paribas) suggesting investors are looking for 43–45%. By comparison, in the September 2025 quarter Google Cloud grew 34% and Microsoft Azure grew 40%.

Amazon confirmed it will report Q3 2026 results on October 29, 2026, with a conference call at 2:00 p.m. PT / 5:00 p.m. ET. The earnings release is published on Amazon's investor relations site the same afternoon.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the year-over-year revenue growth rate of Amazon's "AWS" segment for the third quarter of 2026 (the quarter ended September 30, 2026), based on Amazon's official earnings release scheduled for October 29, 2026 and posted at https://ir.aboutamazon.com/quarterly-results/default.aspx . The value is computed from the AWS segment net-sales figures given in that release: (Q3 2026 AWS net sales − Q3 2025 AWS net sales) / Q3 2025 AWS net sales × 100. For example, Q3 2026 AWS net sales of $45.1 billion versus Q3 2025 AWS net sales of $33.0 billion resolves as 36.7. If the release does not provide the underlying net-sales figures but states the growth percentage directly (e.g., "AWS segment sales increased 37% year-over-year"), that stated figure is used.
question.fine_print: If Amazon postpones its Q3 2026 earnings release beyond October 30, 2026, the question is annulled. If the earnings release is unavailable at the primary link, the figures from the corresponding news release at https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/default.aspx or from [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) reporting Amazon's official results will be used.
